reason: Follow NestJS module, auth, DTO, entity registration, error and logger conventions.
Design Album/Photo/Config entities, relations, indexes and synchronize-compatible persistence.
Keep provider/upload/storage failures inside BusinessException and global response conventions.
Log OSS operations and compensation without credentials, filenames or sensitive metadata.
Place Gallery route, API, hooks, components and auth-sensitive UI according to Vue conventions.
Build the album surface, fullscreen Dialog, fields and responsive states with existing UI primitives/tokens.
Keep upload queue, pagination and Dialog logic outside fat SFCs.
Integrate public status with layout navigation and keep admin mutations in the owning gallery flow.
Own stable gallery contracts and pure helpers in the framework-free shared package.
Use shared interfaces, const maps and root exports without enum/any drift.
Trace config, secret, DB, OSS, CDN, API and UI data across every boundary.
Centralize URL/path normalization, masks, limits and payload projections.
Use verified MapCN, HEIC, EXIF, OSS and repository evidence while implementing.
